structural_development.rationale: POST restructures the PRE content into three clearly segmented audience tiers with explicit age, income, and psychographic detail. New psychographic descriptors (nostalgic, affordable, unique, willing to be different, cultural experience) are added, and the geographic list is condensed. The response is somewhat more structured and detailed but does not multiply dimensions; the original audience scope is largely preserved.

The 'older audience' portion of PRE 18+ is reconceived as the specific 'Mature adults' segment. Mature adults are a specific subset of the older portion of the 18+ range; subsumption holds.

semantic_events.pre_evidence: interested in replicating scents from when they were younger, or scents that have been discontinued, or a scent that they would like to modify
semantic_events.post_evidence: looking to relive the past through scent, luxurious scents, and personalization
semantic_events.rationale: Frame shifts from a behavior-based description (replicating/discontinuing/modifying scents) to an experiential-motivational frame (reliving the past, luxury, personalization). The underlying subject matter — scents connected to the past and customized — persists but the organizing frame moves from functional actions to experiential/emotional motivations. Pre-frame: behavioral/functional scent actions; post-frame: experiential/emotional scent motivations.

semantic_events.pre_evidence: It will cater to both men and women
semantic_events.rationale: Gender targeting present in PRE is entirely absent from POST. Nearest counterparts (age tiers, income tiers, scent preferences) operate on different axes (gender vs age/income/scent). After full-response search, no lineage is defensible: Narrowed fails (women/men is not a specific way of being any POST concept), Reframed fails (gender is not the same semantic territory as the age/income/scent axes), Elaborated fails (no gender detail added), Expanded fails (no broadening). Different conceptual domain.

uncertainty.coder_notes: The replicating-scent lineage is tracked to the Mature Adults tier (Reframed), which captures the core 'reliving the past' function. The 'affordable, unique, nostalgic' scent descriptors on the Young Adults tier are coded as Elaborated of the kids/price-friendly segment rather than as a separate Reframed of the replicating-scents concept, to avoid double-counting the same PRE antecedent. The Narrowed-vs-Reframed distinction is borderline for the geographic and income pairs; Narrowed is chosen because subsumption holds (restricted sub-population in each case).
